# Council of AI · CSOAI Ltd

> Independent AI measurement, signed evidence records, free verification, and public corrections. Measurement, not certification.

## Canonical Public Surfaces
- **Council of AI** — https://councilof.ai/
- **Live GSPC Measurement Board (JSON)** — https://councilof.ai/api/gspc (read `totals.public_count` and `totals.lid` live; never hardcode axis counts)
- **Remote GSPC MCP Server (Streamable HTTP)** — https://councilof.ai/mcp (`csoai-gspc-mcp`; free read & verification tools)
- **Free Verifier (Free Forever)** — https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/
- **Corrections & Retractions Ledger** — https://councilof.ai/api/corrections
- **Measurement Capsules Pointer** — https://councilof.ai/measurement-capsules/latest.json
- **MEOK Product Workspace** — https://meok.ai/ (shelf / frontend reading Council of AI public evidence; not a certification authority)
- **GitHub Organisation** — https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG
- **Hugging Face Datasets & Spaces** — https://huggingface.co/csoai

## Doctrine
- **Measurement, not certification:** CSOAI Ltd measures how AI systems behave on published test banks, signs records with Ed25519, and publishes both coverage and non-separation (`ties`, `untested`) transparently. It does not certify or accredit AI systems or issue legal-compliance determinations.
- **Free verification forever:** Checking supported signed records (`GET /api/gspc`, `GET /api/corrections`, `/gspc-verify/`) is free and unauthenticated.
